en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a lively street scene centered around a public watering place. Several people and animals (notably horses) are gathered around a large stone watering trough. The architecture in the background suggests European-and-Ottoman influenced buildings. The card includes captions in French and English, identifying the location as 'SALONIQUE – Abreuvoir, Rue du Vardar / Watering place, Vardar Street.'
